note: Hand-drawn textbook histology diagrams across the board; only #1 (vessel wall injury) shares the topic.
Liver cut surface. Top-1 is a kidney, but #2, #4 and #5 are livers and #5 is the same alpha-1-antitrypsin case.
Yellow aorta on black matched to yellowish stomach, liver, adrenal and lung specimens. Colour and background, not organ.
Spleen infarct on blue; all five neighbours are infarcts, four of them in spleen.
Adult autopsy photo (classifier called it a diagram). Neighbours are clinical photos of infants; same kind of picture, nothing else in common.
Brain H&E; all five are brain or spinal cord at similar magnification.
Bone-forming spindle cell lesion matched to other stromal H&E (lung, metastatic RCC, cementum). Texture match.
Polycystic kidney; #1 and #4 are cystic kidneys, the rest are other organs on the same blue background.
Heart cross-section; four of five are hearts.
CMV inclusion in kidney (PAS/Alcian blue). Neighbours are high-power H&E with large atypical nuclei from unrelated tissue.
Opened teratoma; top-1 is opened cervix/endometrium (same system), the rest are kidney, larynx, brain.
Neonatal brain with intraventricular haemorrhage; #1 and #2 look like the same case.
Sternum with myeloma on a blue towel; neighbours are larynx, nose, peritoneum, breast on the same towel.
Pale skeletal muscle; #1 and #2 are close-ups of the same specimen.
Synovium in RA; #1 and #3 are synovium, others prostate, teratoma, pemphigus.
Pericarditis; #1 and #4 are hearts, others are red specimens on blue.
Anencephalic stillborn; #1, #2 and #5 are fetuses (two with anencephaly).
Laryngeal carcinoma; top-1 is laryngeal squamous carcinoma, the rest are other opened organs.
Diabetic glomerulosclerosis; all five are glomeruli from renal biopsies, mostly silver-stained ARCH images.
Sickle cell spleen; top-1 is a congested spleen, then lung and three livers with similar dark parenchyma.
Low-power iron stain of pituitary; top-1 is the same entity, the rest are pale low-power brain and soft tissue.
Marrow aspirate with plasma cells; all five are Romanowsky-stained marrow or blood smears.
MAI in lymph node; top-1 is the same diagnosis, the others are granulomas or brain inflammation.
Jaw radiograph; all five are jaw/dental X-rays.
Inflamed intestinal mucosa; #2 to #4 are colitis/crypt images.
Sporotrichosis in skin; top-1 is myeloma marrow (similar dense cellularity), #4 and #5 are the same sporotrichosis case.
Cystic fibrosis pancreas; #1 to #4 are the same diagnosis, almost certainly sister panels.
Malaria smear; all five are P. vivax smears from the same series.
Endocervix at low power; top-1 is endocervical mucosa, the others are mixed mucosae.
Mucicarmine stain of cryptococcus in brain; top-1 is cryptococcal meningitis in H&E at higher power.
Oral mucosal lesion; all five are oral mucosa at the same power, different diagnoses.
Accessory spleens; neighbours are tongue, bladder, kidney, uterus and lung on the same dark towel.
Hydatid cysts of liver (multi-panel); neighbours are oral clinical photos and GI specimens.
Cervix with squamous metaplasia; top-1 is the same diagnosis, the rest are lung and pancreas.
Dilated heart on black; neighbours are uterus, fetus, kidney, testis and skull.
Vertebral column; #1 sternum, #2 rib and #5 vertebrae are all bone.
Neurofibromatosis of skin; neighbours are clinical skin photos with unrelated lesions.
Testis with epididymitis on cyan; neighbours are gallbladder, heart, brain, ovary and kidney.
Cell cycle schematic; all neighbours are schematics, #3 and #4 are also about cell division.
Oral haemangioma; all five are oral mucosal lesions at the same power.
Rib lesion; #1 is the same specimen, the rest are unrelated.
Amyloid, Congo red plus polarisation in two panels; neighbours match the two-panel layout and colours, not the content.
Bright pink bone-like tissue; neighbours share the colour (neuroma, thrombus, urate).
Hodgkin lymphoma; neighbours are lymphoid or histiocytic (thymus, Gaucher, follicular lymphoma), no Reed-Sternberg cells.
Matted TB lymph nodes; #5 is TB of omentum, the rest are larynx, ovary and adrenal.
Whole-mount eye with retinoblastoma (classifier called it a diagram); neighbours are low-power brain, cartilage and a liver lobule diagram.
Sheets of small round cells; all five are small round cell tumours or lymphoid, from different organs.
Kidney transplant rejection; #1 and #3 are the same diagnosis.
Warthin-Starry stain for H. pylori; neighbours are brown IHC; #4 is a silver stain with spirochetes.
Small adrenals on blue; neighbours are spleen, kidney, thyroid and a diagram.
